fields.statement: At 973764aa ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogPRNoCI -v: PASS. It uses local bare repos as fake git remotes and a fake gh PR read. In the clean case watchdogMergeMain adds one merge commit on top of the branch's old head and runs a plain git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch> (no --force, no rebase). Origin's branch then equals the pushed head, and the ship state records Pushed with Head cleared. A second call does nothing. In the conflict case the merge is aborted: HEAD and origin's branch are unchanged, the worktree is clean, a.txt is reported and no ship state is written. In the pass, a clean merge resumes the run. A conflict resumes the run when the workflow has conflict handling (ship check --settled / ship rebase). Otherwise it holds a WatchdogHold that becomes an InboxStalled item. PRs that have checks or are not CONFLICTING are skipped. Read the diff. Also ran go test -run Watchdog ./internal/api (all pass), go vet and gofmt (clean). One run of the Watchdog filter tripped TestMain's guard on ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json. That file is written by the live root daemon; three reruns passed.
